questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 5$ in logarithmic equations, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
A data set recorded for logarithmic equations consists of the four values $\{15, 19, 23, 29\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $15 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 86$, and dividing by $4$ gives $21.5$.
